items.question: How much funding can I receive?
items.answer: The amount you may be awarded depends on your individual situation and the scope of your project. Most foundations typically provide funding ranging from 1000 SEK up to 100,000 SEK per year.

items.question: Is it possible to receive funding from more than one foundation?
items.answer: Yes, you can receive support from multiple foundations at once. However, if you are granted more funds than needed for your intended purpose, you are expected to either allocate the surplus to the same goal or return the excess. Keep in mind that grants are considered gifts and should be used responsibly.

items.question: Do you want to promote a scholarship?
items.answer: You’re welcome to showcase your foundation or scholarship on our platform. Listing your funding opportunity is completely free. Don’t hesitate to reach out.

items.question: What is the delivery time?
items.answer: If you are applying as a private individual, we will get back to you within 2 hours with your tailored scholarship list. For organizations, we will get back to you within 48 hours.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: <0>We’re Alexander Winqvist and Alexander Svensson, two friends who met during our master’s studies at Stockholm University. While studying, we were amazed by the number of Swedish scholarships available, but equally frustrated by how difficult it was to find them and to figure out what they actually funded. That challenge sparked our mission: to make Sweden’s grant and foundation ecosystem accessible to everyone.</0><1>  Our platform uses a blend of AI and structured data to match your unique profile with the most relevant funding opportunities.After a quick form and a one-time payment, you’ll receive a custom PDF report with recommendations sent straight to your inbox. No subscription, no recurring fees, just transparent, one-click access to your next potential funding source.</1><2> We’ve built this for students, entrepreneurs, researchers, and changemakers who don’t have time to sift through hundreds and hundreds of foundation websites. We as founders and our system continuously learn and improve to deliver even smarter results over time. We believe in unlocking funding opportunities, not hiding them behind bureaucracy. Welcome to the smarter and easy way to find Swedish funding.</2>

privacyPolicyContent: Last updated: [2026-06-07]

At StiPo W&S AB, we take your privacy seriously and comply with applicable data protection legislation, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and supplementary Swedish law. This policy explains how we collect, process and protect your personal data.
1.1 Data Controller
The data controller responsible for the processing of your personal data is:
StiPo W&S AB
Company registration number: 559529-3860
Address: Göran Elgfelts Gata 1A, 183 39 Täby, Sweden
Email: kontakt@stipendieportalen.se
1.2 Personal Data We Collect
We collect personal data when you:

– fill in forms or surveys on our website,
– purchase or order our services,
– participate in our activities or contact our customer support.
Depending on your interaction with us, we may process the following categories of data:

– First name and surname
– Contact details (email, phone number)
– Gender and age
– Municipality
– Level of education and field of study
– Information you provide in free-text fields (e.g. the purpose of your application)
– Payment information (handled by our payment provider)
1.3 Purposes and Legal Basis for Processing
We process your personal data for the following purposes, on the legal bases set out below:

| Purpose | Legal basis |
| --- | --- |
| Delivery of the scholarship matching service you have ordered | Performance of a contract (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)) |
| Communicating with you about your order | Performance of a contract (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)) |
| Handling payment and accounting | Legal obligation (GDPR art. 6(1)(c)) — Swedish Accounting Act |
| Improving our service and producing internal statistics | Legitimate interest (GDPR art. 6(1)(f)) |
| Handling complaints and customer support | Performance of a contract (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)) |
1.4 Automated Decision-Making and Profiling

To deliver a personalised scholarship list, we apply automated processing (AI-based matching) to the information you provide, including your field of study, level of study, gender, municipality and the purpose of your funding request. The result is a list of scholarships that our algorithm considers relevant to your profile.

The processing is necessary to perform our contract with you. You have the right to request human review of the result if you believe the automated matching has produced an incorrect outcome. Contact us at kontakt@stipendieportalen.se for this.
1.5 Data Processors and Third Parties
To deliver our service, we share certain personal data with vendors acting as data processors on our behalf. These categories may include:

– Payment provider (for card payments) — e.g. [Stripe / Klarna / other]
– Email provider (for delivering matching reports and communications) — e.g. [SendGrid / Mailchimp / other]
– Web host and hosting provider — one.com
– AI matching provider — Open AI
– Accounting system — Fortnox
Whenever a vendor processes personal data on our behalf, we ensure that a data processing agreement (DPA), or equivalent processing terms, is in place in accordance with Article 28 GDPR.
1.6 Transfers Outside the EU/EEA

Some of our vendors may be based outside the EU/EEA, for example in the United States. When personal data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, the transfer takes place on the basis of one or more of the following mechanisms:

– the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC)
– the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, where applicable
– your explicit consent, where required under GDPR
1.7 Retention Periods
We retain your personal data only for as long as is necessary for the relevant purpose:

– Data related to purchases and delivery: retained for 7 years in accordance with the Swedish Accounting Act.
– Anonymised statistics: may be kept indefinitely.
– Correspondence with customer support: retained for a maximum of 24 months after the matter is closed.
1.8 Security

We use technical and organisational security measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, manipulation or unlawful disclosure. Only authorised personnel have access to personal data, and access is limited to what is needed for the relevant task.
1.9 Your Rights Under GDPR
You have the following rights:

– Right of access — to obtain a copy of the personal data we process about you.
– Right to rectification — to have inaccurate data corrected.
– Right to erasure — to have your data deleted, where compatible with law.
– Right to restriction — to request that we temporarily restrict processing.
– Right to object — to processing based on legitimate interest.
– Right to data portability — to receive your data in a structured format.
– Right to withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent.
– Right to human review of automated decisions (see section 1.4).
– Right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY) — imy.se.
You exercise your rights by contacting kontakt@stipendieportalen.se or calling +46 72-177 33 34. We normally respond within 30 days.
1.10 Cookies and Tracking Technology
Our website currently does not use cookies or similar tracking technology that requires consent. If we add such technology in the future, we will inform you and obtain your consent in advance.
1.11 Disclaimer for External Links

As part of our service, we provide email content and webpages that include information about various foundations and links to external websites. We accept no responsibility for the content, accuracy or availability of external websites, or for any direct or indirect damage that may arise from visiting them.
1.12 Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy. Material changes will be communicated on our website or by email to existing customers. The current version is always available on our website.

2.2 General
These purchase terms apply when you, as a private individual or organisation, purchase services from StiPo W&S AB through our website. By completing your purchase, you accept these terms.
2.3 The Service

We deliver a tailored scholarship list based on the information you provide. The list contains scholarships our AI matching algorithm considers relevant to your profile and is delivered by email within the following timeframes:
Private individuals: within 2 hours of completed purchase.
Organisations: within 48 hours of completed purchase.
Stated times apply on weekdays excluding public holidays.
2.4 Price and Payment
All prices on the website are stated in Swedish kronor (SEK) and include VAT in accordance with applicable Swedish VAT law.
Payment is made directly at the time of order via our connected payment methods, e.g. [card, Swish, Klarna]. The order becomes binding only when payment has been completed.
2.5 Delivery

Our service is digital and delivered electronically by email to the address you provided when ordering. No physical goods are shipped. It is your responsibility to ensure that the email address provided is correct and that our delivery does not end up in your spam filter.
2.6 Right of Withdrawal

Under the Swedish Act (2005:59) on Distance Contracts and Off-Premises Contracts, you as a consumer normally have a 14-day right of withdrawal. However, the right of withdrawal does not apply to digital content delivered electronically if:
delivery has begun with your express consent, and
you have confirmed that you are aware that the right of withdrawal thereby ceases.

At checkout, you actively confirm (by ticking the relevant box) that you consent to the service being delivered immediately and that you thereby waive your right of withdrawal. Without this confirmation, the order will not be processed.
2.7 Complaints

If the service does not work as promised or any fault occurs during delivery, please contact our customer support at kontakt@stipendieportalen.se or +46 72-177 33 34 within a reasonable time. Complaints are handled in accordance with Swedish consumer law, normally within 30 days of receipt of your case.
2.8 Out-of-Court Dispute Resolution
If a dispute between you as a consumer and us cannot be resolved amicably, you as a private individual may turn to:
the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes (ARN) — Box 174, 101 23 Stockholm, www.arn.se.
the EU's Online Dispute Resolution platform (ODR) — ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.
We comply with ARN's recommendations.
2.9 Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
Swedish law applies to these terms and to the purchase. Disputes shall be tried by a general court in Sweden.
2.10 Force Majeure

We are not liable for delays or failure to deliver caused by circumstances beyond our control, such as severe operational disturbances, natural disasters, strikes, war, government decisions or other unforeseen events of a similar kind.
2.11 Acceptance of Terms

By completing your purchase, you confirm that you have read and accepted these purchase terms and that you are aware that the right of withdrawal does not apply to services delivered electronically with your express consent.
